textRuns.value: OLS on log burnt area (EFFIS), country fixed effects, metrics in within-country standard deviations (one value for the whole panel), errors clustered by country, 95 % intervals. Robust: a Bayesian fit (95 % HDI) and the variants agree (year effects, linear trend, EU only, Mediterranean only, fires above 100 ha). Multiplier: factor on burnt area per standard deviation. R²: weather terms, within country, in sample and out of sample. Statistical association, not causation. Line chart: only countries observed in every year.
